ratings_why.fun: One shared, growing Recipe ties every card together, and the Warden, Drawn, Psyche and Herald placement puzzles give real target and slot choices each turn.
ratings_why.distinct: A spell-maker whose payoff can be another tribe's carry is new for Bramble, though Pavonia and the spell-count cards echo familiar Brann and spellcraft patterns.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable now; more passes would change its flavour, not make it better.

points.text: With the Show-Globe Keeper, its End of Turn Phial is always in hand at Start of Turn, so The Uncertain pays for free and the cast-or-hold choice disappears. Paying only for a second held Phial would keep the choice.
Mother Shipton is dead with a keywords-only Recipe. She could also strip one keyword the Recipe holds from her target, so she works in a Dispensary too.
Burnet's line is the only trigger line, and trigger lines are the most combo-rich part of the Recipe. One more trigger line elsewhere (a death or End of Turn line) would widen the line-choice puzzle.
Units keep the lines they got before a line is replaced, so a board carries the Recipe's history. A card that cares about how many different lines a unit holds would lean into that.

standouts.why: Burnt Ring Warden turns one Phial into a row plus Drawn diagonals, a slot puzzle on the zigzag.
The Alchymist steals any tribe's keyword into the Recipe, so Phials hand out Mire, Pack or Cleave: uses outside their purpose.
Psyche's death cast on her neighbours feeds Drawn units beside them, so her slot matters in the fight too.

weakest.why: Mortar Grinder gives a random Moth stats per spell: a plain counter with no placement or line choice.
Atropos is plain shop-spell economy that touches the Recipe only indirectly.
Old Carbonaria is a spell-count stat holder; she does the expected thing.

flags.note: Dame Pavonia doubling every Phial, with the Warden, Drawn neighbours and the Honeysuckle Nurse each firing per cast, compounds fast on a lamp.
Treacle Painter with Hedgerow Acorns, or a cheap shop spell, may turn into a Phial stream.
Mother Shipton with big stat lines plus Burnet's Nightshade can gut a carry before it swings; worth the owner's eye as a feel-bad.
Copied keywords such as Belly, Snap or Pack still need rulings as lines.
